name: ATM
rootCause: Hidden transferFrom Auto-Swap Drain. Lost: ~$243,543 USDT

descriptions.text: Hidden transferFrom Auto-Swap Drain. Lost: ~$243,543 USDT

The ATM token on BSC was exploited due to a flaw in its custom transferFrom() function logic (which automatically swapped ~20% of transferred amounts to BSC-USD). The attacker repeatedly triggered the mechanism to drain approximately $243,500 from the protocol.

On 3 June 2026, ATM Token on BNB Chain was exploited via a flawed transfer mechanism. The attacker repeatedly triggered a swap of 20% of transferred ATM tokens during each sell, draining approximately $243,500 from the liquidity pool. The vulnerable auto-swap logic, combined with weak anti-whale controls, allowed the attacker to farm and drain ATM/USDT LP funds. ATM Token’s custom _transfer function contained an auto-swap feature that sold 20% of every transfer via PancakeSwap.
